Meta.tagline: Find your people by what you love.
Meta.description: Najimi turns what you love into a feed, a map of your people, games with friends and plans it books for you, with an AI agent in every chat and Qloo's taste graph underneath.

Landing.title: Find your people by what you love.
Landing.lede: Tell Najimi a few things you love. It reads your taste through Qloo, plays it back as music and culture, shows where your people are, and puts an agent in your chats that plans, plays and books with your friends.
Landing.footer: Najimi, made for the Qloo hackathon.
